text: In the 24000-step N=64 seed-22 run, layer-1 force peaks at about 0.806 at step 6000, dips to about 0.795 by step 11000, and then recovers slowly. Does the matched-horizon N=128 seed-22 run (run-20261015-214139-70d4) show the same mid-schedule dip? If both arms are plotted as layer-1 control plus margin against log(val_mse_ratio), is the N=64 minus N=128 offset constant at about 0.09-0.11?
